cards.text:
G-TD13/001EN
Enma Stealth Dragon, Kingoku Tenbu
G Unit｜ Nubatama｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000+｜ Shield 0
(This card cannot be in your main deck)
[Stride](Released when both players' vanguards are grade 3 or greater!)-Stride Step-[Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
(When this card strides, it gains the power and card name of one heart. At the end of the turn, return it face up)
Dominate-[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your battle phase, choose up to one of your opponent's rear-guards, [Stand] and dominate it, and attack your opponent's other unit. (You may use its abilities if you pay the cost)

G-TD13/002EN
Secret Message Stealth Hermit, Abudataishi
G Unit｜ Nubatama｜ Grade 4｜ Power -｜ Shield 15000
(This card cannot be in your main deck)
[G Guardian](Usable when both fighters' vanguards are grade 3 or greater, and the number of face up G guardians in your G zone is three or less)-Opponent Turn's Guard Step-[Choose a card with "[Heal] Heal" from your hand, and discard it] Call this card to your (GC) from face down.
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (GC), if the number of cards in your hand is less than or equal to your opponent's, this unit gets [Shield] +5000 until end of that battle.

G-TD13/003EN
Demon Stealth Rogue, Genba
Normal Unit｜ Nubatama｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield 0
Dominate-[AUTO](VC)[Generation Break 1](Active if you have one or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone):[Soul-Blast 1] At the beginning of your battle phase, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, [Stand] and dominate it, and attack your opponent's other unit. (You may use its abilities if you pay the cost)

[AUTO](VC/RC)[Generation Break 1](Active if you have one or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone):When any players' other rear-guard attacks a vanguard during your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.

G-TD13/005EN
Demon Stealth Dragon, Shiranui "Oboro"
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield 0
[AUTO](VC):At the beginning of your ride phase, you may choose a card from your opponent's drop zone. If you do, your opponent calls that card to (RC), and at the end of that turn, retire that unit.
Dominate-[AUTO](VC):When your G unit [Stride], choose up to one of your opponent's rear-guards, [Stand] and dominate it, and until end of turn, it gets [Power] +4000, and attack your opponent's other unit. (You may use its abilities if you pay the cost)
